title: Example Scan Operator
author: ep3p
description: Notice that x = 15 does not have a state whose "parent step" is step 3 . But 11, 12, 13, 14, 16 do. This is because 14 had evaluated step 2 successfully, so in the next event (15) the state from step 2 will take precedence over the state from step 3, and this one will disappear.
